items.title: 17.7.1 Samandari paani se magnesium (Dow process) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the Dow process (PDF 12-13).

blocks.text: Dow process, shayad in mein sab se mashhoor aur sanati taur par ahem, samandari paani ke wasee Mg2+ ions se magnesium dhaat nikalne ka kai qadmi kimiyai aur electrochemical amal hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbon ka flow chart oopar se neeche: samandari paani Mg2+(aq); + Ca(OH)2 se Mg(OH)2 neeche baith'ta hai; chhaan kar + 2HCl se MgCl2(aq) + 2H2O; garha kar, sukha kar aur pighla kar molten MgCl2; electrolysis se cathode par Mg aur anode par Cl2.
blocks.caption: Dow process ke marahil: samandari paani se magnesium (is topic ke liye asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart neeche diye gaye teen mua'adlon (equations) ki tarteeb dikhata hai: Mg2+ + Ca(OH)2 -> Mg(OH)2 + Ca2+, phir Mg(OH)2 + 2HCl -> MgCl2 + 2H2O, phir pighle MgCl2 ki electrolysis: Mg2+ + 2Cl- -> Mg + Cl2. Ca(OH)2 choone ke pathar ya seepiyon se banaya jata hai.

items: Samandari paani ko calcium hydroxide (choone ke pathar ya seepiyon se) se treat kiya jata jo magnesium hydroxide neeche bithata hai: Mg2+(aq) + 2OH-(aq) -> Mg(OH)2(s).
Magnesium hydroxide chhaan kar hydrochloric acid se react karaya jata: Mg(OH)2(s) + 2HCl(aq) -> MgCl2(aq) + 2H2O(l).
Magnesium chloride ka mehlool garha aur khushk kiya jata.
Pighle MgCl2 ko bare cells mein electrolyse kiya jata, cathode par khalis magnesium aur anode par chlorine: MgCl2(l) -> Mg(l) + Cl2(g).

blocks.text: Yeh amal is liye saraha jata hai ke wafir lekin patle zariye se qeemti dhaat bare paimane par nikalta hai, aur is ne magnesium ki paidawar badal di.

blocks.prompt: Dow process ke electrolysis qadam ka mua'adla likhein.
blocks.explanation: MgCl2(l) -> Mg(l) + Cl2(g): cathode par magnesium, anode par chlorine.

items: Ca(OH)2 samandari paani se Mg(OH)2 bithata.
HCl ise MgCl2 banata; pighla MgCl2 electrolysis se Mg aur Cl2.
